author: Michael Larabel
description: Coreboot downstream Libreboot last month enacted an AI policy to forbid contributions made using AI/LLMs. Surprisingly, already, that anti-AI policy has been dropped with AI-based submissions now being permitted...
title: Libreboot Abandons Anti-AI Policy After One Month

author: Michael Larabel
description: A change set to land for the upcoming Linux 7.5 kernel cycle expands the mmap range size for GEM/TTM buffer objects in the kernel graphics drivers from 1TB to now up to 8TB...
title: Intel Preps Linux 7.5 Change To Better Handle Multiple GPUs With Lots Of VRAM

author: Michael Larabel
description: Merged today to GNOME's Mutter compositor is support for the Adaptive Backlight Modulation (ABM) DRM/KMS connector property and a "content-adaptive" API. This GNOME desktop improvement was contributed by AMD as part of modern AMD Ryzen AI laptops supporting Adaptive Backlight Modulation...
title: AMD Contributes Integration For Content-Adaptive / Adaptive Backlight Modulation To GNOME

author: Michael Larabel
description: After teasing the new System76 Thelio Prime last month, this week officially launched their redesigned Thelio Prime mini desktop PC. This AMD Ryzen 9000 series powered creation is quite small with an internal volume of just 9.78 liters but quite capable with up to the Ryzen 9 9900X being supported, AMD or NVIDIA discrete graphics options, up to 96GB of RAM, and up to 16TB of NVMe storage. I have been testing out the new Thelio Prime for the past few days so far and it's been stacking up as well as one of their best compact PCs yet.
title: System76 Thelio Prime: A Petite But Performant AMD-Powered Linux PC

author: Michael Larabel
description: The Fedora Security Special Interest Group (SIG) drafted an Incident Response Policy for the Fedora project. This stems from shortcomings in the Fedora project brought to light during the XZ Utils security fiasco in their communications...
title: Fedora Incident Response Policy Drafted For Improving Workflow & Security Disclosures

author: Michael Larabel
description: With the upcoming Linux 7.5 kernel, the AMDXDNA accelerator driver for supporting the Ryzen AI NPUs is declaring version 1.0...
title: AMDXDNA Driver Reaches Version 1.0, Ryzen AI NPU10 & NPU11 Coming To Linux 7.5

author: Michael Larabel
description: Rust Coreutils 0.13 released today as the newest feature update to this Rust-based re-implementation of GNU Coreutils that is used by Ubuntu Linux and other platforms...
title: Rust Coreutils 0.13 Release Delivers More Performance, Better Compatibility

author: Michael Larabel
description: Vulkan 1.4.369 is out today with a new, currently-experimental Vulkan API extension from AMD to help further enhance ray-tracing performance with modern games...
title: Vulkan 1.4.369 Introduces New AMD Extension For Improving Ray-Tracing Performance

author: Michael Larabel
description: Cloud Hypervisor 55.0 was released on Thursday for this security-minded, cloud-focused virtual machine monitor (VMM) written in Rust. While it started off as an Intel open-source project, it's expanded in scope over time and with more organizations contributing. With the new Cloud Hypervisor 55, a number of ARM improvements to note...
title: Cloud Hypervisor 55 Released With AArch64 Nested Virtualization, Up To 990 ARM vCPUs

author: Michael Larabel
description: Over the past number of weeks Kwi has been in development as a new KDE terminal emulator. Kwi is built off the Ghostty library and delivering magnificent performance over the existing Konsole terminal emulator. Today marks the project's first release...
title: Kwi Sees First Release As KDE's New Terminal Emulator

author: Michael Larabel
description: Following the FFmpeg 9.1 release preparations that began last month, FFmpeg 9.1 is now formally released as the newest feature update to this widely-used, cross-platform multimedia library...
title: FFmpeg 9.1 Released With NVIDIA Optical Flow FRUC, APV Vulkan Encoder
